[SWS_LOG_00238] DLT output of InstanceSpecifier values
⌈
A message argument
of type InstanceSpecifier shall be output as a DLT message payload argument
of type STRG, with TYFM set to UTF-8 encoding, consisting of the result of calling
InstanceSpecifier::ToString.
⌋
